description: This Java class defines a factory for creating and retrieving tree models from XML resources within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load tree definitions from XML files, cache them, and access specific trees by name.

classes.name: TreeFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for loading, caching, and providing access to ModelTree objects defined within XML resource files.

methods.name: getTreeFromLocation
methods.description: Loads a tree resource from a specified location, parses the XML, caches the resulting ModelTree objects, and retrieves the specific tree by name.

methods.name: readTreeDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of ModelTree objects keyed by their names.
